articles.summary: The people closest to a business problem often know what needs to change, but haven’t always had the tools to change it themselves. AI is giving more of them the ability to turn that knowledge into working software, shortening the distance between identifying a problem and solving it. Making that possible across a company means connecting AI to the data, tools, and systems people already use. In The Rise of the Self-Driving Company, Amjad Masad, CEO of Replit, describes a future in which people set direction, exercise judgment, and remain accountable while agents take on more execution. Getting there means giving people the ability to act on their expertise, alongside clear boundaries for the systems and data agents can use. At Microsoft Ignite, we’re expanding our collaboration with Microsoft to help teams create software with the data and tools their business already uses. Today we are excited about enabling three core integrations with Microsoft: Our integration with Microsoft Fabric and Local Work on Windows and Microsoft Teams integration are becoming generally available, alongside early access to Azure deployment options. In addition, we’re proud to be named the 2026 Microsoft Partner of the Year for Startups. Turn business expertise into working applications
articles.title: Build where your business works: Replit at Microsoft Ignite

articles.summary: Today, we’re launching Replit Missions to help your teams take on the complex work they haven't had time or capacity for: winning more enterprise customers, improving product performance, or replacing legacy software. You define the outcome, and Replit coordinates a swarm of agents to plan, build, test, and iterate toward it within the budget and boundaries you set. At Replit, we wanted to explore bringing application monitoring in-house to reduce costs and gain more control. We gave Missions the goal of building DataCat, a platform we could customize and run on our own infrastructure. In two days, within a $3,000 budget, a swarm of agents built dashboards, alerts, and application tracing, then tested the platform against measurable performance and reliability goals. DataCat is one example of the work Missions makes possible. Missions brings the same approach to your team’s goals, without requiring you to build and maintain the complex infrastructure necessary to coordinate an agent swarm. Start with complex work you don’t have the capacity for You can start with a mission like “win our first 10 paying enterprise customers.” You don’t need to decide upfront which industries to target, which buyers to reach, or which customer problem to solve first. Finding and evaluating those approaches is part of the work you delegate. During setup, Missions asks questions to define success. What counts as an enterprise customer for your business? Do paid pilots count toward the first 10, or does success mean signed annual contracts above a minimum value? Your answers shape which accounts the mission prioritizes and how it measures results.
articles.title: Introducing Replit Missions

articles.summary: Today we’re giving Replit Agent two new jobs: buying supplies for your business with Link and Visa, and helping you reach customers with Google Ads. In September 2024, we launched Replit Agent, the first generally available coding agent that enabled anyone to build software by describing it in their own words. That opened the door to a new class of founders: people whose ideas had been held back by the high upfront cost and capability required to build software. But once an idea gets off the ground, a sprawl of new work follows: forming a company, keeping the app running, getting found, buying supplies, reaching customers. Each one is a new barrier to growth, even for engineers who can build the product but don’t know how to find customers. Since May, we’ve seen a ninefold increase in the number of entrepreneurs connecting their Replit-built businesses to Stripe for monetization. We’ve invested more in helping these founders grow, with agents as teammates that expand what they can do. Businesses on Replit can already accept payments, incorporate, find prospects and enrich leads, monitor app health and security, and optimize for SEO using Replit Agent. Today, we’re adding two more jobs, giving Replit Agent the ability to buy supplies and run ads on behalf of businesses, with the owner in full control of the spend. Agentic Commerce powered by Link, built by Stripe, and Visa
articles.title: Replit Agent can now buy for your business and help you reach customers
